124:t_026:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Even if we can't take down $$セントラル・ベース$$, it's a chance to whittle down the Empire's forces.」

124:t_026:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「For the sake of what comes next, I propose we fight as long as we possibly can.」

124:t_026:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「Understood. ...All units, you heard that!」

124:t_026:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Admirable, admirable. As expected of all of you in $c, who fought through the $$時獄戦役$$.」

124:t_026:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Maybe it's because I'm surrounded by so many quiet men... A man who talks lightly grates on me.」

124:t_026:8.en:
$$スザク$$
「Let's do this, everyone. With everything we've got...!」

124:t_026:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Five more minutes... In that time, we wear down the enemy's forces as much as we can...!」

124:t_026:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Be very careful of the enemy $$スフィア・リアクター$$! That machine seems to be forming a special field around itself!」

124:t_026:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$スフィア・アクト$$, huh...!」

124:t_026:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It seems that power differs from Reactor to Reactor.」

124:t_026:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's do it! All units, begin the attack!」

124:t_026:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes, yes, I understand. Let me show them five minutes of hell.」
